events.title: King Saul
events.subtitle: 1st King of United Israel
events.description: The first king of Israel, anointed by the prophet Samuel. Ruled over the united tribes until his death at Mount Gilboa.

events.title: King Ish-bosheth
events.subtitle: Son of Saul (2-Year Reign)
events.description: Saul's surviving son who was proclaimed king over the northern tribes by Abner, while David ruled Judah in Hebron.

events.title: King David
events.subtitle: 2nd King of United Israel
events.description: Anointed king of Judah at Hebron, then king over all Israel. Defeated Goliath, captured Jerusalem as capital, and established the Davidic covenant.

events.title: King Solomon
events.subtitle: 3rd King of United Israel
events.description: Son of David known for his great wisdom, wealth, and for building the First Temple in Jerusalem.

events.title: Rehoboam
events.subtitle: 1 Kings 12–14 | 17 yrs
events.description: Son of Solomon; rejected elders' advice causing the 10 northern tribes to rebel under Jeroboam.

events.title: Abijah (Abijam)
events.subtitle: 1 Kings 15 | 3 yrs
events.description: Fought against Jeroboam of Israel; won a major battle through divine intervention despite personal shortcomings.

events.title: Asa
events.subtitle: 1 Kings 15 | 41 yrs
events.description: A godly reformer who removed idols and defeated the Ethiopian army; relied on Syria later in life.

events.title: Jehoshaphat
events.subtitle: 1 Kings 22 | 25 yrs
events.description: Sent teachers with God's Law throughout Judah; made an unwise military alliance with Ahab.

events.title: Jehoram
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 8 | 8 yrs
events.description: Married Athaliah, Ahab's daughter; introduced Baal worship to Judah and murdered his brothers.

events.title: Ahaziah
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 8 | 1 yr
events.description: Followed the house of Ahab; killed by Jehu while visiting King Joram of Israel.

events.title: Athaliah (Queen)
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 11 | 6 yrs
events.description: Usurped the throne after her son's death and attempted to exterminate the royal line of David.

events.title: Joash (Jehoash)
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 12 | 40 yrs
events.description: Hidden as a child by Jehoiada the priest; repaired the Temple, but lapsed after Jehoiada died.

events.title: Amaziah
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 14 | 29 yrs
events.description: Defeated Edom; grew proud and challenged Northern Israel to war, resulting in Jerusalem's wall being breached.

events.title: Uzziah (Azariah)
events.subtitle: 2 Chronicles 26 | 52 yrs
events.description: Strengthened Judah militarily and economically; struck with leprosy for arrogantly burning incense in the Temple.

events.title: Jotham
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 15 | 16 yrs
events.description: Rebuilt the Upper Gate of the Temple and fortified Judah; served as co-regent during Uzziah's leprosy.

events.title: Ahaz
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 16 | 16 yrs
events.description: Practiced child sacrifice, closed the Temple doors, and paid Assyria for protection against Israel and Syria.

events.title: Hezekiah
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 18–20 | 29 yrs
events.description: Judah's greatest reformer; destroyed the high places, built Hezekiah's Tunnel, and prayed as God destroyed Assyria's siege.

events.title: Manasseh
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 21 | 55 yrs
events.description: Judah's longest-reigning and most wicked king; shed innocent blood, but repented late in life while captive in Babylon.

events.title: Amon
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 21 | 2 yrs
events.description: Continued Manasseh's idolatrous practices without repenting; assassinated by his own servants.

events.title: Josiah
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 22–23 | 31 yrs
events.description: Boy king who discovered the Book of the Law, purged idol worship, and celebrated Passover; killed fighting Egypt at Megiddo.

events.title: Jehoahaz
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 23 | 3 months
events.description: Ruled 3 months before Pharaoh Necho deposed him and took him in chains to Egypt where he died.

events.title: Jehoiakim
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 23–24 | 11 yrs
events.description: Placed on throne by Egypt; burned Jeremiah's prophetic scroll; experienced Nebuchadnezzar's first siege (605 BC).

events.title: Jehoiachin
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 24 | 3 months
events.description: Surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar and was carried captive to Babylon along with Ezekiel and Judah's nobility.

events.title: Zedekiah
events.subtitle: 2 Kings 24–25 | 11 yrs
events.description: Judah's final king; rebelled against Babylon resulting in the destruction of Jerusalem and Solomonic Temple in 586 BC.
